sections.text:
Ability Power 330. Damages all enemies with physical dark damage.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Increases the stats of all allies by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Increases the max HP of all allies by 30% for 40 seconds.
-Recovers 20 Cost for your character.
[Additional Unison Effect] Heals HP of all allies by 20% of their max HP every 5 seconds for 30 seconds.
[Unison Effect Boost] Extends the 20-Cost recovery effect to all allies.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 5000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 5000
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases Unison gauge gains for all allies by 3 for 50 seconds.
Only [Demon] Hendrickson can be used as Unlocking Potential material
